# Charts, Canvas & Maps opens with its map, and two records leave

## Context

#21140's target (body of Wed 18 Nov) takes Charts, Canvas & Maps from 0 cards to 6 at the cut. The group publishes none today. The Component shelves rows on #21142 (comment 6980244557) opened and used every entry. Two entries stay as they are: the OpenStreetMaps map and the graph scene. Two records leave: `canvas`, which draws nothing by design, and `cesium-js`, which failed 3 runs of 3.

This leaf publishes the map and removes the two records. The graph scene moves to the group's second leaf, with Sparklines, Mermaid and the renewed chart. Its 100k frame cannot be captured deterministically yet: in five runs the recipe caught different frames, and nothing in the DOM says when the canvas worker has drawn a scene.

A leaf of #21140, cornerstone 1 of Engine 14 (`ROADMAP.md`), cut Mon 23 Nov. It is the Component shelves lane's first content, in review by Fri 20 Nov 12:00 CET.

## The Problem

- `examples.json` on `dev` `0128668721` holds five `charts` records: `canvas`, `graph-scene`, `cesium-js`, `open-street-maps` and `am-charts`. All five carry `image: null`, and `Portal.model.Example.publishes()` needs a cover, so the group shows nothing of its own.
- `example-captures.json` declares only `grid-table`, `gantt` and `scheduler`. No recipe exists for `charts`.
- The map's tiles load from the OpenStreetMap servers after the page is ready, and nothing in the DOM says when they are drawn. A first capture caught the earthquake markers over a blank dark area.
- `canvas`: the stage stays empty; `examples/component/canvas/canvas.mjs` only logs that it loaded, and the record's own `lookFor` says the example "draws nothing on it yet". `cesium-js`: `Cesium is not defined` at `src/main/addon/CesiumJS.mjs:51` in 3 runs of 3.

## The Architectural Reality

- Records: `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, one rule for a card in `Portal.model.Example.publishes()`, groups as data (#21141).
- Covers: `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` reads recipes from `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` and writes bytes for `neomjs/pages` `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/`, which `Portal.view.examples.List#imageBasePath` serves. A recipe waits on DOM state only (`ready`, `after`); the dark theme comes from the example's own `themes` order, as in `grid/bigData`.
- The map: `src/main/addon/OpenStreetMaps.mjs#create` builds the OpenLayers map in the main thread, which raises `loadstart` and `rendercomplete`.
- Design authority: #21140 design 4 and 7. A demonstration gets a cover card, and every cover is taken in the dark theme.

## The Fix

1. `src/main/addon/OpenStreetMaps.mjs`: the map element carries `data-rendered`, `false` on `loadstart` and `true` on `rendercomplete`. It is the DOM fact a recipe or a test waits on.
2. `examples/component/wrapper/openStreetMaps/neo-config.json`: `themes` lists the dark theme first, so the example opens as its cover shows it.
3. `example-captures.json`: declare `charts`, plus one dark recipe for `open-street-maps` that waits on `data-rendered`.
4. `examples.json`: an `image` for `open-street-maps`; `canvas` and `cesium-js` leave the catalog. Their folders stay, with every spec that loads them.
5. A companion `neomjs/pages` pull request carries the cover; both bodies list its checksum.
6. Every spec that pins catalog or group counts follows.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The Charts, Canvas & Maps page publishes the OpenStreetMaps card beside `offscreen-canvas` (its `alsoIn`), in each build mode that has its URL.
- [ ] One `--family charts` run reproduces the cover, and two runs write identical bytes.
- [ ] A unit arm pins `data-rendered` across `loadstart` and `rendercomplete`, and fails without the addon change.
- [ ] **Look:** the pull request shows the cover at 340 px and the group page at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, before and after, dark. One cold reader of the builder's seat reads the unlabelled pair before code review.
- [ ] `canvas` and `cesium-js` are gone from `examples.json`; their folders and specs stay.
- [ ] The companion `neomjs/pages` pull request is linked, with the checksum.
- [ ] The whole unit suite passes locally.

## Out of Scope

The graph scene, Sparklines, Mermaid and the renewed chart: the group's second leaf. `am-charts` renders no text (defect-note a2375219, Discussion #20309). The CesiumJS addon's load order (defect-note b408f593). The Shell, Tiles and Find lanes.

## Avoided Traps

- A light cover beside dark ones (design 7).
- A cover captured on a timer: the tiles finish when they finish, so the recipe waits on `data-rendered`.
- A graph-scene cover that differs from run to run, accepted because one run looked right.
